dedupe_keys.name: rapidmapping emergency copernicus eu flood hazard datasets

description: rapidmapping.emergency.copernicus.eu: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rapidmapping.emergency.copernicus.eu. Coverage: the area served by rapidmapping.emergency.copernicus.eu. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Povodne v povodí Moravy, stav k 18.09.2024 - Copernicus EMS; Povodne v povodí Moravy, stav k 19.09.2024 - Copernicus EMS; Povodne v povodí Dunaja - Komárno, stav k 21.09.2024 - Copernicus EMS; Povodne v povodí Moravy, stav k 15.09.2024 - Copernicus EMS. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/deed.sk), as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
